CCollins_CiviScribe_SaveImage.description: Save PNG, JPEG, or WebP images with Civitai-compatible metadata.

positive_prompt_override.name: Positive prompt override
positive_prompt_override.tooltip: Optional text connection that replaces automatic positive-prompt detection for metadata only.

negative_prompt_override.name: Negative prompt override
negative_prompt_override.tooltip: Optional text connection that replaces automatic negative-prompt detection for metadata only.

filename_prefix.name: Filename / subfolder pattern
filename_prefix.tooltip: Filename or safe subfolder prefix. Supports date, width, height, and batch-number tokens.

output_format.name: Output format
output_format.tooltip: Image format. PNG and WebP are lossless by default; JPEG is lossy.

jpeg_quality.name: JPEG quality
jpeg_quality.tooltip: JPEG fidelity. 100 is the maximum-fidelity default.

jpeg_alpha_background.name: JPEG alpha background
jpeg_alpha_background.tooltip: RGB background used when JPEG must flatten transparent pixels.

webp_quality.name: WebP effort / quality
webp_quality.tooltip: WebP compression effort or lossy quality.

write_sidecar_json.name: Write sidecar JSON
write_sidecar_json.tooltip: Also write deterministic metadata JSON beside each saved image.

include_workflow.name: Embed ComfyUI workflow
include_workflow.tooltip: Include the sanitized ComfyUI workflow when metadata supports it.

include_civitai_manifest.name: Embed Civitai manifest
include_civitai_manifest.tooltip: Include the structured Civitai manifest in rich metadata and sidecars.

enable_civitai_lookup.name: Enable Civitai lookup
enable_civitai_lookup.tooltip: Ask Civitai to identify active resources from hashes. Only hashes or a model-version ID are sent; images, prompts, workflows, and paths are not.

preferred_primary_model_air.name: Preferred primary AIR or Civitai URL
preferred_primary_model_air.tooltip: Optional AIR, Civitai model URL, or model-version ID that pins the active primary model identity.

hashing_mode.name: Hashing mode
hashing_mode.tooltip: cached_only reads no model bytes; cached_or_fast uses caches and fast hashes; full may read whole model files.

lookup_timeout_seconds.name: Lookup timeout (seconds)
lookup_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Maximum Civitai lookup wait. Saving continues after a timeout.

lookup_cache_results.name: Cache successful lookup results
lookup_cache_results.tooltip: Store successful identities locally so later saves can resolve them without another request.

advanced_manual_identities_enabled.name: Enable manual resource identities
advanced_manual_identities_enabled.tooltip: Enable the advanced JSON mapping for pinning identities of multiple active resources.

manual_resource_identities_json.name: Manual resource identities JSON
manual_resource_identities_json.tooltip: Advanced JSON list of explicit resource identity mappings. Invalid data is reported safely and never blocks image saving.
